1.title: Oregon coast vacation
1.content: I remember going to the Oregon coast with Dad and Michael when we were little. I think it was summer 1986. We rented a tiny cottage near the beach. My strongest memory is building sandcastles together.

2.title: Oregon coast vacation
2.content: I remember a family trip to the Oregon coast. Dad took us crabbing but we caught nothing. He bought crab from a fisherman at the dock and joked that he had caught it himself. I'm not sure of the year, possibly 1987.

3.title: Family beach photograph
3.content: A faded photograph shows three children building a sandcastle on the Oregon coast. The back of the photograph is handwritten 'Summer 1986'. The children appear to be Sarah, Michael, and their cousin Lisa, based on Helen's identification.

4.title: Grandma's kitchen on Sundays
4.content: Mom made bread on Sundays. She always gave the children the first warm slices after church.

5.title: Grandma's bread baking day
5.content: I remember Mom baking bread on Saturday evenings, not Sundays. She put the bread on the kitchen windowsill to cool.

101.title: Canal bicycle afternoon
101.content: I remember cycling beside the canal in 2009. Leo got a puncture near the lock. We walked the bicycles to a repair shop. Leo called it our slowest cycling race.

103.content: I think the canal ride was in 2010, though I am not certain. My bicycle got a puncture. Iris and I walked to the repair shop. I joked that we were in the slowest cycling race.
